sql: select count(*) >= 1 from approval_queue where created_by = 'agent:kd_listing' and object_type = 'listing_sync' and object_id like 'a4:price_drift:%'
select count(*) >= 1 from approval_queue where created_by = 'agent:kd_listing' and object_type = 'listing_sync' and object_id like 'a4:title_drift:%'
select count(*) >= 1 from approval_queue where created_by = 'agent:kd_listing' and object_type = 'market_alert_s1'
select count(*) from approval_queue where created_by = 'agent:kd_listing' and (payload::text like '%fixture Thử IT%' or title like '%fixture Thử IT%')
select count(*) = count(distinct object_id) from approval_queue where created_by = 'agent:kd_listing'
select count(*) from approval_queue where created_by = 'agent:kd_listing' and status <> 'pending'
